findings.title: Reject concatenated signatures with an incorrect length
findings.body: concatenatedRSToASN1DER copies only signLength bytes without checking signature.length. A signature containing a valid R/S pair followed by arbitrary extra bytes is therefore converted to exactly the same DER signature as the valid input and can pass verification, despite not being a valid JOSE ECDSA signature. Short inputs instead cause an unchecked array-copy exception. Require signature.length == signLength and reject mismatches with IOException before copying.

findings.title: Exercise the actual curves and verify the converted signature
findings.body: All three tests generate the same default EC key (typically P-256), including testES384 and testES512. Changing the digest algorithm does not change the key's curve, so these tests never exercise 384-bit R/S values or the long-form DER sequence length used by P-521 signatures. Additionally, comparing only the two concatenated outputs can pass if the first conversion corrupts or truncates the original signature. Generate keys with the corresponding explicit curve for each algorithm and verify the reconstructed DER signature against the original data and public key.
